purpose: Held-out discovery-only prompts, authored from independent task categories without reusing the outcome case prompts. Freeze before measuring; do not optimize on this set.

variants.description: Implement nontrivial software changes, fix defects across code and tests, address code review feedback, or adapt in-progress work when requirements change. Use when the task needs repository rules, verification, and a reviewable handoff, including new project setup or adopting a delivery workflow. Skip isolated mechanical edits, code explanations, and standalone README writing.

Use for software work that must be made reviewable: building a feature, repairing a defect, resolving review findings, or revising an implementation after scope changes. Preserve repository decisions and verify the resulting code. Also use for project setup and delivery-workflow adoption. Do not use for isolated renames, explanatory questions, or standalone documentation edits.

Use when continuing a software change through implementation, testing, and review: finish a feature, resolve actionable review comments, fix a behavior regression, or reconcile changed requirements with existing code and decisions. Also supports new project setup and delivery guidance. Skip trivial mechanical changes, code explanations, and standalone README tasks.

prompts.prompt: Implement bounded retries for the event consumer. Cover transient errors and exhausted retries, and leave the patch ready for review.
Our calendar export shifts recurring appointments across daylight-saving time. Reproduce it, repair the conversion and test the boundary dates.
Add cursor pagination to the audit endpoint while keeping existing clients working. Check ordering and duplicate events.
The reviewer found a socket leak and an untested timeout path in the streaming client. Fix valid findings and explain any you disagree with.
Work through the database migration review comments. Preserve the rollback guarantee and update the verification evidence.
The sync implementation is halfway done. Product now needs offline edits to survive reconnects. Revisit the design and finish the behavior with tests.
We started with one account per workspace, but the approved requirement now allows multiple accounts. Adapt the permission checks and migration plan.
Deliver account deactivation across the API and background jobs. Existing retention rules still apply; show what was verified.
Start a small local webhook receiver with signature validation, setup instructions and tests for accepted and rejected requests.
The last cache change serves stale inventory after an update. Trace the invalidation path, fix the regression, and check concurrent requests.
Rename the local variable tmp to total in this function; make no other changes.
Explain what the regular expression ^[a-z]+[0-9]*$ matches.
Write a short README describing these existing command-line options. Do not change code.
Format this JSON with two-space indentation without changing its values.
